coordinate_system.description: All positions in the plan are 3D Slicer RAS world coordinates in mm: x = patient right, y = anterior, z = superior.

si_joint.description: Per sacroiliac joint: what it measured, which side the surgeon declared disrupted, and how much of the joint was counted as bone (DECISIONS.md section 2).

pilot.description: The blinded pilot (DECISIONS.md 4.3): when the surgeon planned without the tool's checks and when they were revealed, the corridors where he found no screw, and the comparison with the tool's suggestions.

reduction.description: The virtual reduction that screws tagged "reduced" were planned on: each moving unit's rigid transform (scanned to reduced world, 4x4), the remaining error per region in mm, and who proposed it (DECISIONS.md 3.4, 3.6). Empty when there is none.

guidance.description: Aiming guidance derived from the validated screw: direction in words, the C-arm view down it, and the room around its entry.

source.description: auto: the tool's suggestion; adjusted: a suggestion the surgeon moved; surgeon: placed by the surgeon himself (the pilot).

surgeon_judgment.description: The surgeon's own verdict on this screw: breach (bool), would_use (bool).

tip_rule.description: inside: the tip stays in bone with the full margin; through: it passes the far cortex by up to one catalogue step (DECISIONS.md 1.5-1.6).

anatomy.description: The anatomy the screw was planned and is checked on (DECISIONS.md 3.4).
